official: 品川区附属機関の構成員の報酬および費用弁償に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第2回定例会 提出議案

name: いじめ関連委員会の報酬日額を改定
summary: 現在、2つのいじめ関連委員会では、委員長の報酬日額は23,000円、委員は20,000円です。この議案で、委員長は30,000円、委員は23,000円に改め、条例は公布の日から施行します。
changes: 委員長の報酬日額を23,000円から30,000円に改める
委員の報酬日額を20,000円から23,000円に改める
who: 品川区いじめ問題調査委員会と品川区いじめ対策委員会の委員長・委員
why: 両委員会の委員の報酬日額を改定する必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Revises daily compensation for bullying-related committee members
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Concerning Compensation and Reimbursement of Expenses for Members of Affiliated Bodies of Shinagawa City
en.summary: The chairpersons of the two bullying-related committees currently receive ¥23,000 per day, and committee members receive ¥20,000 per day. Under this bill, the daily rate will be changed to ¥30,000 for chairpersons and ¥23,000 for members. The ordinance will take effect on the date it is promulgated.
changes: Raises the chairperson’s daily compensation from ¥23,000 to ¥30,000
Raises a committee member’s daily compensation from ¥20,000 to ¥23,000
who: The chairpersons and members of the Shinagawa City Bullying Investigation Committee and the Shinagawa City Bullying Prevention Committee
en.why: The ward says this is because the daily compensation for members of both committees needs to be revised.
